reasoning: The PKGBUILD performs standard binary repackaging: downloads a pre-built .deb from the project's official GitHub releases (mak-kirkland/chronicler) over HTTPS with pinned SHA-256 checksums, extracts it with `ar x` in prepare(), and installs files into $pkgdir in package(). No eval, curl|bash, or execution of fetched content. The Makefile uses only trusted Arch packaging tools (pkgctl, makepkg, namcap). All other files (.SRCINFO, .nvchecker.toml, LICENSE, REUSE.toml, .gitignore) are non-executable metadata. The deepseek model successfully reviewed all 8 files and found them safe; the qwen and openrouter models had tool errors but also found files safe when they did succeed.

learnings: Tool reliability: Implement retry logic or fallback models when API requests fail with HTTP 400/429 errors to avoid incomplete audits
